events.text: The Optica project began with Edgley Aircraft Limited, formed by John Edgley.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Optica project began in 1974 with a company , Edgley Aircraft Limited

events.text: Institutional investors bought into the project and set up a production line at Old Sarum Airfield in Wiltshire.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1982 , institutional investors bought into the project and set up a production line at Old Sarum Airfield

events.text: The aircraft received UK certification.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Over the next three years , the company was built up to full manufacturing capability , the aircraft received UK certification

events.text: The first customer aircraft was delivered.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Over the next three years , the company was built up to full manufacturing capability , the aircraft received UK certification , and the first customer aircraft was delivered

events.text: The business went into receivership and John Edgley was forced out.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the business went into receivership , and John Edgley was forced out

events.text: With new owners, aircraft on the production line were completed and the Optica entered service.
events.subject: self
events.quote: With new owners , aircraft on the production line were completed , and the Optica entered service

events.text: The Optica made its maiden flight, flown by Squadron Leader Angus McVitie.
events.subject: self
events.quote: made its maiden flight on 14 December 1979 when it was flown by Squadron Leader Angus McVitie

events.text: The Optica entered production.
events.subject: self
events.quote: entered production in 1983

events.text: Edgley Aircraft Limited obtained its initial Civil Aviation Authority certification.
events.subject: self
events.quote: obtained its initial Civil Aviation Authority certification on 8 February 1985

events.text: The Optica and the Sprint were offered to John Edgley.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 2007 , they were offered to John Edgley

events.text: G-BOPO had a first return-to-service flight as a UK demonstrator.
events.subject: self
events.quote: with a first return-to-service flight on 3 June 2008

events.text: Interflight Global announced plans to start a valuation of the dormant Optica programme.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In August 2016 Interflight Global announced plans to start a valuation of the dormant Optica

events.text: InterFlight Global completed its valuation.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In December 2016 , InterFlight Global completed its valuation

events.text: InterFlight Global delivered an LOI to AeroElvira.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in June 2017 , delivered an LOI to AeroElvira

events.text: IFG modified its initial program re-launch efforts.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At the end of 2018 , IFG modified its initial program re-launch efforts

events.text: IFG continues to seek a strategic OEM partner to re-launch the program.
events.subject: self
events.quote: As of the end of 2019 , IFG continues to seek for a strategic OEM partner

events.text: Optica G-KATY crashed, killing its Hampshire Constabulary pilot and his photographer passenger.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 15 May 1985 , Optica G-KATY crashed , killing its Hampshire Constabulary pilot and his photographer passenger .

events.text: G-BMPL sustained damage to the ducted fan and hub assembly and minor airframe damage while in flight.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 11 March 1990 , G-BMPL , while in flight , sustained damage to the ducted fan and hub assembly and minor airframe damage .

events.text: Flight International featured Edgley Optica in the air.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Edgley Optica in the air Flight International 1980

events.text: Flight International published Optica Revisited.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Optica Revisited Flight International 1985
